Package model.table

Class Reservation

java.lang.Object
model.table.Reservation
public class Reservation extends Object
src/model/table/Reservation.java
Author:
Uriel Neves Silva (https://gitlab.com/a253119un), Carles Conesa Mañosa (https://gitlab.com/carlesconesa34) Records a Customer's claim on a specific Table during a specific Shift on a given date. Created by ReservationManager and stored in the Customer's reservation list. cancel() frees the table slot so another customer can book it. Reservation — Relationships association → Customer: Links the reservation to the customer. association → Table: Links the reservation to the table. association → Shift: Links the reservation to the shift. composition ← ReservationManager: The reservation manager creates and manages reservations.

      public void setStatusFromPersistence(ReservationStatus status)
      Sets status directly when rebuilding a reservation from persisted state. This bypasses transition guards used by runtime business operations.
      Parameters:
      status - Persisted reservation status.

    • isModifiable

      public boolean isModifiable()
      Returns whether the reservation state can still be modified. Only PENDING reservations are modifiable (can change their state). Once ACTIVE or in any terminal state, the reservation is locked. Note: Orders can still be created/modified in ACTIVE reservations separately.
      Returns:
      true if status is PENDING
